speaker_role: essay coach at consultancy (SCORE: Your College Counselor)
commercial_incentive: Sells essay help through its own service and promotes it in the video.
key_insights: Vary sentence length and replace vague words with precise ones.
For why-this-school prompts, research mission and values, courses and professors; do not paste from other essays.
Avoid opening with background dumps; begin at a dramatic moment and reveal context gradually.
Keep the busy reader in mind; rhetorical questions or acknowledging their fatigue are suggested tactics.
specific_numbers_or_facts: Speaker says a Georgetown applicant's essays highlighted Jesuit values and were admitted.
Speaker claims top universities receive over 50,000 applicants a year and that many applications go unread; unsupported.
notable_or_distinctive: Mostly generic writing tips with a Georgetown example of using institutional values.
reliability_notes: Video is about five years old; several claims about readers and unread applications are unsupported and the vocabulary advice is debatable.
